question: For instance display names matching the pattern "prime", list each 2014-created instance display name and system-metadata key where the maximum instance memory is greater than 16000 MB, along with the minimum completed migration ID and the average instance memory (MB) for completed migrations (considering only non-deleted instances). Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    i.display_name,
    ism.`key`,
    MIN(m.id) AS min_migration_id,
    AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb
FROM 
    instances i
JOIN 
    migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
JOIN 
    instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
WHERE 
    i.display_name LIKE '%prime%'
    AND YEAR(i.created_at) = 2014
    AND i.deleted = 0
    AND m.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
    i.display_name,
    ism.`key`
HAVING 
    MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000
